title: Beehive-like interior of the craft and a pyramid-shaped holding field
place_text: On board a craft, South Dakota

tellings.quote: there were just multi levels with with all these small Grays everywhere going to and fro and doing whatever they were doing
there were just multi levels with with all these small Grays everywhere where going to and fro
tellings.difference: Dates it to 1977 and does not mention the pyramid-shaped holding field.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Mario Woods describing the beehive-like levels inside the craft with small Grays moving to and fro.

as_told.title: Beehive-like craft interior
as_told.place_text: aboard craft near November 5, South Dakota

plain: A man named Mario Woods says he was taken on board a craft in South Dakota and saw an interior like a beehive, with many levels and small Grays, short grey-skinned beings, "everywhere going to and fro"; the story as recorded also includes a pyramid-shaped field that held him. Woods tells it as his own experience, and in a second telling he dates it to 1977 rather than the 1960s and leaves out the pyramid-shaped field.
